mapper.insert: insert into weight_log (user_id, weight_kg, record_date, note, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{weightKg}, #{recordDate}, #{note}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, user_id, weight_kg, record_date, note, create_time from weight_log where user_id = #{userId} and record_date >= #{since} order by record_date asc, id asc
